cards.title: Grounded Email QA
evidence_topics: Stanford CS329Z HW1 test_email_qa.py, scripted model replies and support-ID shape check

semantics.given: An incoming email question and the provided callable that returns email records for a query.
semantics.when: The QA component uses the provided plain LMCallable and at most the search-hop budget to collect evidence.
semantics.then: Return an answer plus support list containing only IDs obtained from search calls in the same request.
semantics.inputs_outputs: Input is question, search(query,k) and LMCallable; output is a dict with answer string or null and support list of strings.
semantics.forbidden: Do not cite email IDs that were never returned by search or expand beyond the permitted search-call budget.
semantics.negative_case: Scripted model emits an unsupported ID, malformed reply or requests repeated searches without grounded evidence.
semantics.unknown_effect: No external mutation is demanded by this adapter; if an actual tool effect is unknown, its owner must read back before retry.
semantics.replay: Repeating a deterministic fixture should preserve the bounded-call and evidence-reference contracts, without claiming a live score.
semantics.oracle: Stanford HW1 tests/test_email_qa.py verifies the answer/support shape, returned IDs and search-hop budget.
semantics.original_owner: Homework adapter consumer/test runner remains the test owner; FactoryWeaver cannot declare a test PASS.

links.applicability: A question is answered with returned email support IDs.
links.counterfactual: If support validation changes, the selected QA acceptance and its negative controls must be reviewed.

cards.title: Email QA deterministic controls
evidence_topics: Stanford CS329Z HW1 test_email_qa.py scripted test_hop_budget_and_shape_for_any_reply

semantics.subject: Validate the Grounded Email QA output and allowed retrieval loop.
semantics.oracle: Course-provided deterministic scripted tests checking dict shape, returned support IDs and a finite search budget.
semantics.producer: The actual course test runner selects and executes this oracle; it has not run inside FactoryWeaver.
semantics.positive_control: A reply grounded in a returned search email must cite only that email and retain correct output types.
semantics.negative_control: Malformed reply or unknown support ID must not create fabricated evidence or unbounded retrieval.
semantics.observation_status: NOT_RUN: reading a test definition or preflighting this Card cannot establish course test PASS.

semantics.producer: The actual source reader or Host that can retrieve and inspect the published PDF pages.
semantics.affected_scope: Slide-grounded RAG concept notes only; the separately read HW1 test contract remains usable.
semantics.next_source: Obtain PDF page images/text and record page/figure-level factual claims before creating or updating C cards.
semantics.unaffected_work: Existing verified homework interfaces and deterministic acceptance definitions remain separate.
